strings.A new retention applies to snapshots tak: En ny lagringstid gäller versioner som tas från och med nu; de som redan tagits behåller sin.
Spara varje version minst en dag.
strings.No more snapshots are taken. The snapsho: Inga fler versioner tas. De sparade versionerna tas bort när deras tid är ute, och sedan försvinner säkerhetskopian.
strings.One folder (a disk, USB disk or network: En mapp (en disk, USB-disk eller nätverksresurs)
strings.Pool of swappable disks (plugged in one: Pool med utbytbara diskar (ansluts en i taget)
strings.One fixed path: an internal disk, a USB: En fast sökväg: en intern disk, en USB-disk som oftast sitter i, eller en monterad nätverksresurs. Varsto läser och skriver den på den sökvägen; när den inte finns där är lagringen bara otillgänglig. Om du byter mellan flera diskar, välj en pool i stället.
strings.Several disks you plug in one at a time,: Flera diskar som du ansluter en i taget, till exempel gamla diskar som förvaras på en hylla. Varsto känner igen varje disk på en markeringsfil, inte på sökvägen, fyller den med det som poolen ännu saknar, kontrollerar den när den kommer tillbaka och säger vilken disk som ska anslutas för en fil som ligger på en disk som är borta.
strings.A bucket at any S3-compatible provider (: En bucket hos valfri S3-kompatibel leverantör (AWS, Scaleway, Hetzner, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, MinIO med flera), med dina egna nycklar.
strings.Any remote you have set up in rclone, fo: Valfritt fjärrmål som du har konfigurerat i rclone, till exempel Google Drive, OneDrive, SFTP eller WebDAV.
strings.Add a folder, an S3 bucket, an rclone re: Lägg till en mapp, en S3-bucket, en rclone-fjärrplats eller en pool med utbytbara diskar nedan.
strings.fills in the endpoint, region and URL st: fyller i slutpunkt, region och URL-stil; du kan fortfarande ändra dem
strings.Headline prices of each provider's stand: Huvudpriserna för varje leverantörs standardklass, från de inbyggda prisuppgifterna. Priserna anges i leverantörens egen valuta och räknas inte om; kontrollera källan innan du bestämmer dig.
Egen server: det finns inget leverantörspris. Ersätt slutpunkten med din egen servers adress.
strings.These prices were verified more than 90: Dessa priser verifierades för mer än 90 dagar sedan och kan ha ändrats; kontrollera källan.
strings.The prices were not verified for this re: Priserna har inte verifierats för den här regionen; den kan ha andra priser.
strings.Replace the part in braces in the endpoi: Ersätt delen inom klammerparenteser i slutpunkten med ditt eget värde, till exempel ditt konto-id.
strings.Runs an older version that does not tell: Kör en äldre version som inte berättar detta
strings.Does not share its activity with this de: Delar inte sin aktivitet med den här enheten
strings.Stored data can decay without anyone not: Lagrade data kan förfalla utan att någon märker det. Bakgrundstjänsten läser, inom en budget, om varje block i dina lagringar och anslutna diskar, vem som än skrev det, och varje synkroniserad fil på den här enheten, så att allt kontrolleras minst en gång under perioden. Ett skadat block repareras från en annan kopia. En fil på den här enheten som ändrats utan att redigeras skrivs aldrig över: den flyttas undan som namn.damaged-datum och den synkroniserade versionen läggs tillbaka. Kall lagring läses bara om du tar med den.
strings.Everything is re-read at least once in t: Allt läses om minst en gång under den här perioden. En körning läser högst så här mycket; externa lagringar kan debitera nedladdningarna.
strings.Most MiB per run from this device's disk: Högst MiB per körning från den här enhetens diskar
strings.Most MiB per run from remote storages: Högst MiB per körning från externa lagringar
strings.Checking the files of folder «{s}» for b: Kontrollerar filerna i mappen «{s}» för bitröta
strings.By default every block goes to every sto: Som standard skrivs varje block till alla lagringsplatser. Kryssa i lagringsplatser eller platser för att bara skriva den här mappen dit; en plats betyder alla lagringsplatser i den, nu och senare. Block som redan har lagrats ligger kvar där de är tills du flyttar dem; reglerna räknar ändå varje kopia.
strings.Tick the device (or devices) this transf: Kryssa i enheten (eller enheterna) som den här överföringsdisken tas till. Den bär de block som de fortfarande saknar och töms i takt med att de tar emot dem. Kryssa inte i någon för att bära det som någon enhet saknar.
strings.some blocks are only on pool disks: vissa block finns bara på poolens diskar
strings.the disks are cheaper and faster than th: diskarna är billigare och snabbare än nätet
strings.The network does not have every block: t: Nätet har inte alla block: diskarna behövs.
strings.The interface starts in your system's th: Gränssnittet börjar i systemets tema; reglaget kommer ihåg ditt val.

What they could read until now they can still read, and their storage credentials work until you change them at the provider. Remove and wipe also orders their devices to delete their keys, sync state and folder contents the next time they reach a storage. The log records who did this. This cannot be undone.

Afterwards print a new recovery kit: the old one does not open new data. This cannot be undone.

An organization adds administrators who approve devices, remove people with every device of theirs at once, set what members may do, and keep a signed log of it. Nothing changes for a vault without one.
Appoint or dismiss with the root words
Ask the person to read the six words their device shows. Approve only if they match exactly: different words mean the code was changed on its way.

By default every block goes to every storage. Name storages or places (comma-separated) to write this folder only there. Blocks already stored stay where they are until you move them; policies still count every copy.
Cold storage: written, never read without confirmation
Disk group: one copy of every block (no rule)
Disks are added one by one below once the pool exists. Each disk takes encrypted blocks until its reserve is reached; a disk that is away is remembered, and files on it say so.
Encrypted objects are written to every storage. Varsto never sends a key anywhere; a storage sees only sealed blocks.
Encrypted on this phone: files are kept as encrypted blocks and open only in Varsto. Selective sync chooses which ones are kept here.

Its keys and ledger copy are removed; your files stay. You will need the vault key to join again.

One key opens this Strongroom; if it is lost, so is the folder. Enrol a backup key and keep it somewhere safe.

Open a folder under Files and press Share to create a token for another Varsto user. Ask them for their request code first to seal the token to their device.

Reading a cold storage starts a retrieval, which your provider may bill and which can take hours. Read it to repair the copies that exist only there?
Remove a device you no longer use, or one that was lost or stolen: it stops syncing and cannot read anything written afterwards. Add one with Add a device under Peers.
Remove the encrypted blocks of every downloaded file of this folder from this phone

Removes this device's vault configuration: its keys, the ledger copy, sync state and any folder grants. Your files stay where they are, and nothing on the storages or on other devices is touched. Afterwards the setup screen appears and you can create a new vault or join one again.

Removing a key does not change the folder key. After removing a key someone may have kept, or if you suspect the key leaked, re-key the folder: it gets a new key wrapped for every enrolled key (touch each one), everything is re-encrypted and the old copies are deleted.
Run this in a terminal on this computer with the security key plugged in:
Selective sync: files appear as placeholders until you download them
Shown from memory: nothing is saved on this phone. Open in another app and Share hand a decrypted copy to that app.
Signed by the administrator devices and chained, so nobody can change it afterwards without the others noticing.

Step 1: send an administrator the request code from this device. Step 2: read its six-word fingerprint to them over a call or in person; they see the same words. Step 3: paste the approval token they send back.

Step 1: send the owner a request code from this device (it carries the device name above). Step 2: read its six-word fingerprint to the owner over a call or in person; they see the same words. Step 3: paste the sealed token they send back.

The background service downloads, within a budget, blocks that other devices wrote, checks their hash and records the check in the ledger, so "verified by another device within N days" stays true. Cold storages and transferrers are never read; nothing runs while the service is paused or locked.
The background service watches your folders and serves this interface on this computer only. Quitting stops syncing until Varsto is started again.

The key stops opening the folder and its wrap is deleted from the storages. The folder key itself does not change, so a removed key that was kept could still open an older copy of the records. The last key always stays.
The name does not match, so nothing was changed.
The token carries the vault key and the storage settings, sealed to this device's request key; only this device can open it.
This cannot be undone; share again with a new token.

This device becomes the first administrator and every device in the vault today belongs to the person you name. You will be shown the organization's root words once: they appoint and dismiss administrators and are not stored on any device.
This device is not in the organization yet: the other devices ignore what it writes until an administrator adds it (Organization page on their device, or varsto org add-device).
Vault key: the 24 recovery words or the hex key
Verify sizes, apply pending deletes, add new blocks

When verification or a storage check finds a block missing or damaged on one of your storages, the service writes it again from another copy: another storage, this device's files or encrypted blocks, or a peer. Cold storages are read only when you ask; transferrers are never written.
With fewer than 2 copies, losing one storage can lose data: add a storage or a policy that asks for more copies.
Write it down and keep it offline: it is the only way to add other devices or recover the data. It is shown once.
Write these down and keep them offline, away from the vault's recovery kit. They are not stored on any device and are needed only to appoint or dismiss administrators.

You get the folder key only: this device can read and write that folder, nothing else of the other vault. A sealed token (vst1… or vst2…) can be opened only here, and this device checks that the owner confirmed its fingerprint; a plain token carries the key itself.
You will be shown the vault key once. Write it down and keep it offline; it is the only way to add other devices or recover the data.

Your devices exchange encrypted blocks directly: on the LAN automatically, across the internet through NAT with hole punching, and when that fails through one of your own reachable devices acting as a relay. Blocks are verified by name; a peer needs the vault key and a known certificate to get anything.
